items.title: Hypothesis and context

items.body: Treatment completion rose from 21.1% to 24.8%; control moved from 21.0% to 21.8%. The observed separation is consistent across four weeks, while the support-contact guardrail moved by +0.08 points against a +0.15 limit. This descriptive comparison does not prove the effect will persist after the novelty period.

items.title: Interpretation

items.detail: The four-week signal is promising but does not establish persistence. Stop if support-contact change exceeds +0.15 points.
items.statement: Extend to 25% exposure with a support-contact stop
